baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic construction places the addressee upon khuluq at word 3, enlarged by azim at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The character branch supplies an inward disposition that becomes visible in dealings with people, while the greatness branch gives that disposition scale and force. The praise is therefore not merely for isolated courteous acts but for an interior orientation sturdy enough to govern relations.

activation_trace.role: The inward-disposition branch supplies the moral substrate and its expression through social conduct.
The magnitude-and-strength branch makes the disposition capacious and effective rather than merely decorative.

changed_reading.after: You stand upon an inward disposition of unusual scale and strength that governs how you meet others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Khuluq at word 3 and its adjective azim at word 4 permit measure and bulk to interact inside the focus phrase.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measuring and proportioning activates khuluq as an ordered design, and the greater-part branch of azim makes that design comprehensive. Great character can thus be read as a proportioned moral whole whose parts cohere, not one spectacular virtue detached from the rest.

activation_trace.role: The measuring-and-proportioning branch supplies an ordered design rather than an accidental cluster of traits.
The bulk-or-greater-part branch expands the design across the main body of conduct.

changed_reading.before: A single moral quality is praised superlatively.
changed_reading.after: The praise concerns a large-scale, internally proportioned moral order rather than one exceptional act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The aptitude branch of kh-l-q and the standing branch of greatness remain attached to khuluq azim in the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Khuluq can name fitness or readiness, while azim can mark honored standing. Their conjunction makes character an aptitude proportioned to a weighty public position, not only a private possession.

activation_trace.role: The worthiness-and-aptness branch supplies readiness for a demanding role.
The social-honor branch gives the aptitude a public field in which it bears standing and responsibility.

changed_reading.before: Character is an excellent quality possessed by the addressee.
changed_reading.after: Character is also the fitness by which the addressee can occupy weighty standing without being deformed by it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The spatial force of being 'upon' khuluq allows the surface branch of kh-l-q and the bone branch of greatness to remain live.
baseline_models.mechanism: A level surface and a hard skeletal member combine into a material analogy: character is the load-bearing plane and frame beneath conduct. This is form-distant from ordinary moral vocabulary, but the preposition makes the structural reading visible rather than arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: The smooth-level-surface branch supplies the plane on which a stable stance can be imagined.
The bone branch supplies a hard internal frame that can bear moral weight.

changed_reading.before: Character is a psychological trait located inside the person.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, character is the level, skeletal support upon which the person's whole stance rests.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pared writing instrument and the aligned written row activate the focus ayah's proportioned surface as repeated, legible practice. Character becomes an inward pattern continually inscribed by conduct, not an invisible essence insulated from observable traces.

activation_trace.role: The proportioning branch gives habituated conduct an ordered template.
The inward-disposition branch keeps the model anchored in character rather than reducing it to handwriting.
The branch of paring hard material to make it even supplies disciplined shaping before a trace can be made.
The aligned written row supplies visible recurrence and makes the shaped disposition readable across acts.

structural_cues: The oath by the writing instrument and what is written immediately precedes the defense and praise of the addressee.
The focus construction presents character as a stable platform, compatible with a repeatedly laid-down line.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an evened writing tool and an aligned trace; I supply the arrow from repeated inscription to habituated conduct. A live alternative is that writing functions only as external testimony rather than as an analogy for character formation.

changed_reading.before: Great character is a hidden inward possession.
changed_reading.after: Great character is an inward order made legible through repeated, aligned acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Grace and lordly cultivation relocate the source of greatness away from self-enlargement. The denial that reason is covered also turns the praise into a diagnostic reversal: what opponents name inner disorder is presented as a cultivated, coherent disposition.

activation_trace.role: The inward and potentially acquired disposition is the object that grace and nurture can form.
The self-magnifying branch supplies the nearby false model that bestowed cultivation displaces.
The good-state and blessing branch supplies the enabling gift around the defended interior.
The nurture, repair, and completion branch supplies formation rather than self-production.
The branch of reason being covered supplies the accusation whose reading of the interior is reversed by the focus praise.

structural_cues: The denial of madness by the Lord's grace is followed by uncut reward and then the emphatic character praise.
The same second-person addressee carries the defense, reward, and character clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blessing, nurture, and the negated covering of reason; I infer that cultivation explains the coherence being praised and excludes self-aggrandizement. The live alternative is that these are adjacent but independent reassurances.

changed_reading.before: The adjective 'great' could suggest personal magnitude or elevated self-regard.
changed_reading.after: The greatness is a graced and cultivated coherence, precisely opposed to both inner disorder and self-magnification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing, assaying, path, and gentle guidance convert character from static reputation into tested orientation. Pressure reveals the material of the disposition, and the revealed disposition shows whether conduct actually travels a guided way.

activation_trace.role: The inward-disposition branch provides the material whose direction and quality can be revealed.
The heart-insight branch turns future seeing into discernment of underlying moral orientation.
The assay of metal or person supplies a pressure test that makes hidden quality manifest.
The extended traversable path supplies direction and continuity to the revealed disposition.
The gentle indication toward path and truth identifies the positive orientation of the tested character.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from reciprocal seeing to the tested one and then to straying, path, and guidance.
The character praise stands immediately before this promised disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discernment, assay, a path, and guidance; I infer that pressure exposes character as directional consistency. A live alternative is that the test vocabulary diagnoses only the accusers and does not describe how the praised character becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Great character is a settled reputation already known by praise.
changed_reading.after: Great character is directional material whose quality becomes publicly discernible under assay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's perfume application becomes a rejected surface-counterfeit when obedience to deniers is prohibited and reciprocal oiling is desired. Great character is not agreeable coating; it is inward integrity able to refuse the social smoothing by which falsehood seeks mutual accommodation.

activation_trace.role: The perfume-paste branch supplies an attractive applied surface that can imitate moral beauty without being disposition.
The inward-disposition branch supplies the durable interior against which cosmetic accommodation is tested.
The compliance-and-accommodation branch names the social yielding explicitly refused.
The opposition to truth identifies the content that seeks accommodation rather than harmless sociability.
The oil-and-coating branch activates the material contrast between applied sheen and inward character.
The soft social placation branch turns mutual oiling into a mechanism of collusive compromise.

structural_cues: A prohibition on obeying deniers is followed by their wish for reciprocal softening.
The repeated verb in 68:9 makes the desired compromise explicitly mutual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compliance, falsehood, coating, and placation; I infer that the applied-surface branch of the focus root is activated as a counterfeit of character. The live alternative is that oiling is only an idiom for compromise and has no material dialogue with kh-l-q.

changed_reading.before: Excellent character should maximize agreeableness and reciprocal conciliation.
changed_reading.after: Great character includes refusal: it distinguishes humane conduct from the polished reciprocity that asks truth to become compliant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counter-portrait forms a social mechanism: injury is applied to persons, walks between them as leaked speech, and culminates in blocked good and crossed limits. Against it, great character is an architecture of circulation that neither transmits harm nor closes the route by which benefit reaches others.

activation_trace.role: The branch that joins inward disposition to dealings with people anchors the model in relational character.
The greater-part branch expands character from isolated exchanges to the main social field.
The branch of faulting and attacking people supplies the initial interpersonal injury.
The branch of walking with slander supplies the carrier that moves injury through a community.
The branch of speech escaping as malicious report supplies the harmful content being circulated.
The withholding hand supplies the terminal blockage of beneficial flow.
The inclination toward useful good identifies what the anti-character system prevents from moving.
The crossing of limits shows the circulation mechanism expanding into structural violation.

structural_cues: The intensive descriptors run without a finite narrative break across 68:10-13.
Movement, speech, withholding, and boundary-crossing appear in causal order even though the text presents a portrait.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interpersonal attack, movement, leaked speech, withholding, good, and transgression; I supply the causal arrow that reads them as a circulation system. A live alternative is that the items are an additive vice list with no intended process order.

changed_reading.before: Great character is primarily private temperament and polite one-to-one behavior.
changed_reading.after: Great character governs social circulation: it stops injury from traveling and keeps useful good from being blocked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence distinguishes technical capacity from moral proportion. The owners divide and plan, exclude an exception and the vulnerable entrant, and arrive confident in ability; their measure ends in deprivation, while the just middle voice exposes the defect. The focus root's measuring branch therefore becomes ethical apportionment rather than efficient design alone.

activation_trace.role: The measuring-and-proportioning branch supplies the focus model that the garden's malformed planning revises.
The allocation of shares supplies the distributive problem latent inside the owners' sworn plan.
The branch of taking something out of a total supplies the omitted exception and the plan's refusal of openness.
The condition of poverty supplies the vulnerable person whom the plan is designed to exclude.
The branch of effective capacity supplies the owners' confidence that they can execute the plan.
The planning-by-measure branch mirrors the focus root while exposing that calculation can remain morally misshapen.
The loss of the desired good reverses the owners' attempt to make deprivation fall only on someone else.
The just and excellent middle position supplies the corrective measure within the group.

structural_cues: The plan moves from oath, to no exception, to exclusion of the poor, to confidence in capacity, and then to deprivation.
The corrective speech comes from the group's middle member after the failed measure becomes visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies division, omitted exception, poverty, planning capacity, deprivation, and a just middle; I infer that moral measure must govern who benefits from effective power. A live alternative is that the episode targets impiety in planning without making distributive character the focus.

changed_reading.before: Great character is a well-proportioned personal design.
changed_reading.after: Great character is right measure in the use of power and goods: capacity remains malformed when it erases exception and the vulnerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interrogative sequence refuses false equivalence and demands judgment, record, study, and enacted truth. It activates the focus alternatives of fabricated speech and social honor: genuine great character is a publicly testable pattern that can discriminate and fulfill, not prestige manufactured by assertion.

activation_trace.role: The fabrication branch supplies the counterfeit mode in which a moral reputation could be invented by speech.
The social-standing branch supplies the public claim that must survive evidentiary testing.
The making of something into a condition supplies the challenged classification of unlike moral states.
The branch of judgment between people supplies accountable discrimination rather than flattering equivalence.
The record that establishes an obligation supplies the demanded warrant for a claimed outcome.
The branch of repeatedly reading and retaining a record supplies scrutiny rather than unsupported assertion.
The fulfillment of promise in action supplies the final test that joins truthful claim to performance.

structural_cues: Successive questions in 68:35-41 demand a basis for moral equivalence, judgment, entitlement, oath, guarantee, and partnership.
The sequence repeatedly moves from a claim to the evidence or agent that would have to sustain it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies classification, judgment, warrant, scrutiny, and fulfilled truth; I infer that the focus praise names standing verifiable in conduct rather than fabricated prestige. A live alternative is that the forensic sequence concerns final judgment only and does not feed back into the character praise.

changed_reading.before: Great character grants elevated public reputation.
changed_reading.after: Its public standing is evidentiary: a coherent record of distinctions and fulfilled action, not honor manufactured by saying it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between being called to lower oneself while sound and being unable when coercive humiliation arrives reverses a vertical assumption in the focus phrase. Being 'upon' great character does not mean rigid elevation; its strength is the capacity to descend voluntarily without losing integrity.

activation_trace.role: The inward-disposition branch makes bodily lowering an expression of character rather than mere posture.
The arrogant self-enlargement branch supplies the vertical counterfeit that voluntary lowering defeats.
The ability branch makes the issue a cultivated moral capacity, not merely receipt of a command.
The branch of lowering and humility supplies the voluntary downward movement true greatness can perform.
The humbled lowering branch supplies the later posture after the opportunity for willing response has passed.
The breaking under domination distinguishes imposed collapse from chosen humility.
The soundness branch marks the earlier intact condition in which voluntary lowering remained possible.

structural_cues: The same people are called to lower themselves both at disclosure and previously while sound, but only the later scene states inability.
Voluntary posture is contrasted with eyes forced low and humiliation covering them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ability, chosen lowering, prior soundness, later forced lowliness, and humiliation; I infer that great character is vertically flexible rather than self-elevating. A live alternative is that the scene describes ritual capacity without commenting on the semantics of greatness.

changed_reading.before: To be upon great character is to occupy an elevated moral rank.
changed_reading.after: True moral height is the intact strength to lower oneself willingly before elevation hardens into coerced collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stage-by-stage movement, extended time, longitudinal solidity, and restraint under distress give greatness a temporal axis. Character is great not only because it is large at one instant but because its inward orientation remains coherent through delay and incremental pressure.

activation_trace.role: The inward and acquired disposition supplies the pattern that must persist through time.
The strength branch is revised from static magnitude into sustained capacity.
The taking of something degree by degree supplies incremental rather than sudden pressure.
The extension and respite of time supplies the duration across which integrity must hold.
The extended solidity branch supplies tensile continuity rather than momentary hardness.
The restraint of the self from panic supplies the practiced response required during delayed judgment.

structural_cues: Gradual drawing and temporal respite precede the direct command to remain patient for judgment.
The focus praise occurs before a long sequence in which outcomes are delayed, reversed, and disclosed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incremental movement, extended time, solidity, and restrained response; I infer that duration is the dimension along which greatness is tested. A live alternative is that the temporal vocabulary describes divine action while patience alone describes the addressee.

changed_reading.before: Great character is a large and strong state visible in the present.
changed_reading.after: Its greatness is tensile and temporal: it keeps its orientation through prolonged, staged pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compressed outcry of the fish's companion is not the end of his moral identity: grace catches him, his Lord selects him, makes him into a new state, and places him among the sound. This activates the focus branch that includes acquired disposition and makes great character a graced, corrigible formation rather than immutable temperament.

activation_trace.role: The branch spanning innate and acquired disposition allows character to be formed and repaired rather than fixed.
The blocked outlet after fullness supplies the crisis state in which pressure constricts expression.
The catching-up and reaching branch supplies intervention before the crisis hardens into final blame.
The blessing and good-state branch identifies grace as the enabling condition of repair.
The nurture, correction, and completion branch supplies the agentive process of moral formation.
The selection-and-nearness branch supplies restored relation after the constricted failure.
The transformation into a condition supplies actual change of moral state rather than relabeling.
The opposition of soundness to corruption supplies the repaired destination of the trajectory.

structural_cues: The warning not to resemble a constricted caller is followed immediately by grace intercepting exposure and blame.
Selection and being made among the sound follow the crisis rather than precede it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constriction, interception by grace, nurture, selection, transformation, and soundness; I infer a repair trajectory relevant to the acquired side of khuluq. A live alternative is that the later figure is only a warning example and that his restoration should not define the focus addressee's character.

changed_reading.before: Great character is a flawless temperament already possessed in fixed form.
changed_reading.after: Character is a maintained and corrigible formation: pressure can expose a constriction, while grace, correction, and renewed relation can restore soundness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus phrase's spatial platform becomes dynamically tested at the close: opponents nearly dislodge the addressee from his station through hostile sight after hearing the reminder, then verbally cover his reason. Great character is moral traction that resists a sensory and linguistic attempt to move him off his ground.

activation_trace.role: The level-surface branch gives the preposition 'upon' a concrete station whose stability can later be tested.
The bone branch supplies an internal frame that resists displacement when the surface becomes precarious.
The near-performance branch keeps the threatened displacement at the brink and makes retained stance salient.
The branch of sliding from a station on ground where feet do not hold supplies the precise destabilizing action.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the hostile visual channel through which displacement is attempted.
Auditory reception supplies the event that triggers the hostile gaze.
The restoration of something to active presence supplies what the opponents hear and resist.
The branch of saying or attributing what is not so supplies the labeling attack after visual displacement fails.
The covering of reason supplies the hostile label that tries to reinterpret stable character as inner disorder.

structural_cues: The closing accusation repeats the madness charge denied before the focus praise.
Hearing the reminder precedes hostile sight, near-displacement, and verbal relabeling in one sentence.
The focus construction says the addressee is 'upon' character, while 68:51 threatens removal from a station.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-action, literal slipping from a station, hostile sight, heard reminder, false attribution, and covered reason; I infer that the focus platform is moral traction under attack. A live alternative is that the slipping image concerns physical harm alone and does not reactivate the spatial grammar of 68:4.

changed_reading.before: Being upon great character is a static metaphor for moral elevation.
changed_reading.after: It is a contested station: great character supplies traction against attempts to displace, stare down, and relabel the addressee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins concrete perfume, smooth-surface, smooth-road, and slipping branches across distant domains. It remains anchored in kh-l-q at the focus word, the spatial force of being 'upon,' and the explicit coating and slipping cues later in the packet. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy about ethical traction, never as a lexical translation of khuluq.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root at word 3 contains both applied perfume and a smooth level surface, while the sentence places the addressee upon that character.

activation_trace.role: The applied perfume branch supplies polished moral appearance as a possible surface layer.
The smooth level surface supplies both composure and the latent risk of lost friction.
The smooth-road branch converts reciprocal accommodation into a path made easy but potentially slick.
The loss of footing on a smooth place reveals the ethical danger hidden inside mere polish.

changed_reading.before: Polished manners are straightforward evidence of great character.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, polish can reduce moral friction until one slips; greatness is the traction beneath a composed surface.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates the worn-cloth branch of the focus root rather than its ordinary disposition branch. It remains unusually well anchored by later branches that explicitly join wear with testing and study with threadbare cloth. Downstream prose should qualify it as a textile analogy for durability under use, not claim that khuluq in 68:4 means worn fabric.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kh-l-q at focus word 3 has a branch for cloth made threadbare by use, and azim at word 4 can supply the strength that survives such use.

activation_trace.role: The worn-fabric branch supplies repeated use and abrasion as the material field in which character is exposed.
The strength branch supplies integrity that can persist when the surface is worn.
The branch of becoming worn through use directly echoes the focus root's textile branch.
The branch of testing until condition appears converts abrasion into moral disclosure.
The worn-cloth branch under study supplies a second link between repeated handling and revealed condition.

changed_reading.before: Great character is great because it appears pristine and complete.
changed_reading.after: Great character is verified like material under long use: abrasion reveals whether its underlying pattern remains coherent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a branch-distant hydraulic model, surprising because it links a water-holding hollow in the focus root to barriers, blocked outlets, and collected water elsewhere. It remains anchored in the focus word and in packet-supplied containment branches, while the reader supplies the release-versus-hoarding relation. Downstream prose should call it an exploratory analogy for holding pressure or bounty without obstructing beneficial flow.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kh-l-q at focus word 3 includes a hollow or newly made well that retains water, allowing character to be imagined as moral capacity rather than only moral description.

activation_trace.role: The water-holding hollow supplies an interior capacity able to receive and retain what arrives.
The barrier between a person and what is sought supplies the danger that containment turns into obstruction.
The sealing of an outlet after fullness supplies pressure trapped by over-containment.
The collected water or basin branch supplies gathering that need not itself become blockage.

changed_reading.before: Character is a list of admirable qualities.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, character is a reservoir-like capacity: it can hold gift and pressure, but greatness requires that holding not become blockage or hoarding.

strongest_changes: The praise moved from private good manners to a relational system that governs how harm and benefit circulate.
The garden sequence transformed proportion from efficient planning into moral apportionment constrained by exception and the vulnerable.
The lowering scenes reversed greatness from rigid elevation into the intact capacity for voluntary humility.
Gradual pressure, patience, grace, and repair gave character both temporal endurance and corrigibility.
The closing slipping scene reactivated 'upon' as moral traction under hostile sight and relabeling.
summary.what_was_special: The focus phrase held several coexisting mechanisms because kh-l-q offered disposition, measure, aptitude, surface, wear, perfume, and reservoir branches, while the preposition 'upon' made their material and spatial activation unusually productive. The context did not merely add virtues; it repeatedly tested whether character can be inscribed, assayed, circulated, proportioned, lowered, repaired, and kept from slipping.
remaining_uncertainties: The surface, textile, and hydraulic models are strongly traceable but may remain analogical activations rather than intended lexical senses.
Several mechanisms read packet order as causal sequence even where the ayat can also function as additive portraits or independent scenes.
Azim remains live as strength, bulk, honor, and rejected self-magnification; the focus alone does not collapse these branches into one.
The restoration in 68:48-50 may illuminate character formation generally without describing the source or history of the focus addressee's character.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A stable moral bearing.** `خ ل ق B004` is inner disposition and conduct toward people; `ع ظ م B001/B010` supplies greatness, strength, and social standing. The preposition *ʿalā* pictures the addressee as established upon this disposition, while 68:10-13 provides an antithetical catalogue of social conduct. I infer repeated conduct -> stable bearing; the ayah reads as an enacted social constitution, not an isolated compliment.
2. **Character as measured formation.** `خ ل ق B001/B003` adds prior measuring and well-proportioned form. Later `ق د ر B001/B005` and `ح ك م B004` activate a packet-wide concern with measure, deliberation, and firmness. I supply the move from material proportion to ethical proportion; *khuluq* therefore becomes a character whose greatness consists partly in ordered measure, contrasting with transgressive excess (`ط غ ي B001/B002`).
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The garden owners' progression from secret exclusion to confession (68:23-32) made “character” read as a stable way of handling power, property, correction, and loss. 68:48 then supplied the positive pressure-test: great character includes restraint while a judgment unfolds slowly.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Character as a calibrated measure.** Fixed `خُلُق` activates `خ ل ق B001` (measuring and proportioning before execution), with the pen/rows of 68:1, the assay of `مَفْتُون` in 68:6, and the path distinction in 68:7 supplying instruments of comparison. The packet gives measure-like forms and a disputed person; I infer that stable conduct serves as the standard by which the dispute is tested. `خُلُق` consequently reads as an ordered moral proportion, not merely a private temperament.
2. **Greatness as public standing resistant to negotiated polish.** Fixed `عَظِيم` activates `ع ظ م B010` (social honor and standing). The symmetrical compromise desired in 68:9 supplies an attempt to manufacture reciprocal approval; I infer that genuine standing derives from measured character and therefore cannot be produced by accommodation. The adjective reads as durable moral authority rather than sheer magnitude.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:9 was the surprise: reciprocal oil-like smoothing exposed why fixed `عَظِيم` could activate genuine social standing (`ع ظ م B010`). Character's greatness became authority that does not need negotiated polish.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The opening pen and closing facial brand belong to one material semiotics: inscription may preserve truth, fabricate reputation, or fasten an identity to a body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Coating and Pattern Can Beautify or Misstate a Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Oil, pigment, dye, and fine patterning alter a body or textile until its visible state may conceal its underlying condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: oil coating (`quranic:root_000497:B001/m01`); soft social dissimulation (`quranic:root_000497:B002/m01`); iridescent cloth (`quranic:root_001252:B010/m01`); patterned cloth that “lies” by appearance (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); close ornamental lines (`quranic:root_001557:B007/m02`); contrasting fleck or gleam (`quranic:root_001557:B008/m01`); perfumed pigment (`quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`); visible beauty mark (`quranic:root_001650:B005/m01`); dye-bearing plant (`quranic:root_001650:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The reciprocal “oiling” of 68:9 expands into a surface technology. Applied substances and textile patterns can produce genuine adornment, but they can also make an appearance assert what the underlying material does not warrant.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Covers Regulate Access to Sight and Interior Truth

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The charge of madness is reframed as an argument about covered interiors: eye-films, shields, shelters, ribs, and unspoken thought all test what observers can legitimately infer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Covered Mind and an Unspoken Interior
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Thought and disposition are enclosed inside the chest; madness is imagined as the mind being covered or lost, while interior speech remains unvoiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: concealment from sense (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); mind covered by madness (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`); hidden heart or inward matter (`quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`); reason or property lost in derangement (`quranic:root_001128:B007/m01`); speech held in the mind (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); inward disposition (`quranic:root_000434:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The accusation “mad” purports to read an inaccessible interior. The branch imagery instead distinguishes hidden thought, durable disposition, and a mind overtaken by derangement, preventing those states from collapsing into one polemical label.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The person appears as a built interior: ribs and bone hold the chest, and the tongue projects what the chest contains. This anatomical scene gives material form to the pericope’s contrast between inward character and outward verbal aggression.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Assay Exposes Formation and Moral Texture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Pressure reveals whether a formed thing is sound, rough, delayed, brittle, or fit for its intended work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Character is treated like material under assay: measured before formation, tested by fire or ordeal, and disclosed through hardness, lag, excess, and capacity for repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measured Formation Produces Shape, Disposition, and Fitness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Material is measured before cutting, brought into a balanced form, and judged fit for a role; human disposition is the inward analogue of that formation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prior measuring and proportioning (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); creative production (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); complete balanced form (`quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`); inward disposition (`quranic:root_000434:B004/m02`); fitness and readiness (`quranic:root_000434:B005/m01`); magnitude and force (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`); awe before a great matter (`quranic:root_001029:B007/m01`); honor and dignity (`quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Great character is a formed capacity, not a decorative epithet. Measurement, balanced shape, inward nature, readiness, magnitude, and earned awe compose a precise account of moral constitution.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pride Hardens; Repair Restores Fit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Self-magnification and head-raised anger harden a person against correction, while repair, exchange, and selection restore useful form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: arrogant self-enlargement (`quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`); angry raised-head pride (`quranic:root_000404:B004/m02`); imposing judgment on another (`quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`); nurture and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m02`); material or practical repair (`quranic:root_001119:B001/m01`); transformation or replacement (`quranic:root_001119:B003/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pride is a deformation of magnitude into self-hardening. The counter-process is not mere condemnation but correction: tend, repair, exchange the damaged state, and select what is genuinely fit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rock Pool, Oil Basin, and Deep Water Store
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Natural and made depressions catch water; their stone edges and depth determine whether the collected resource remains available.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rainwater caught in a rock hollow (`quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`); oil vessel or mountain pool (`quranic:root_000497:B005/m01`); sea or water-rich well (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); abundant collected water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m02`); soft pale basin-stone (`quranic:root_000121:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Provision is stored by topology: hollow, vessel, well, and stone rim. This compact hydrological mechanism usefully pressures the language of favor by showing the material infrastructure through which water becomes durable benefit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Fitted Parts Make Shelters, Implements, and Cuts
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material becomes functional by cutting, joining, tensioning, or arranging parts into a load-bearing whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The writing tool belongs to a larger craft world of stitched leather, tent frames, bows, lots, clubs, and terminal cuts; “whole” and “part” are physical operations before they become discourse categories.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stitched Leather Stretches Across a Wooden Frame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Poles, ribs, and saddle wood support a fitted leather or cloth cover whose seams create a protected interior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: carrying frame or tent poles (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`); leather dome or groundsheet (`quranic:root_000156:B004/m02`); ribs and house-posts (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m02`); saddle wood (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`); leather saddle-cover (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m02`); protective screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m02`); joining two hides or cloth panels (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The shelter is a distributed assembly: frame, posts, saddle wood, cover, and seam. Its coherence rests on fitted tension, giving the pericope a concrete model for how separate parts become a protective whole.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lot-Arrows and Game-Sticks Turn Cut Wood into Decision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Pared shafts are collected in a container, cast as lots, or used as striking sticks, turning shaped wood into an instrument of selection or play.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lot-arrow (`quranic:root_001252:B004/m01`); hide container holding arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); stick for striking a game-piece (`quranic:root_001272:B008/m01`); heavy levering tool (`quranic:root_000980:B003/m02`); carrying implement (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m02`); saddle timber (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m02`).

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir kişinin bir iş veya sonuç için uygun, yaraşır ve bunu yapması beklenebilir durumda olmasını ortak anlam olarak verir. Hazırlanmış olmak bu uygunluğu açıklayan bir benzetmedir; gerçek bir hazırlık işlemi zorunlu değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ağır biçimde başa gelen, insanı sıkıştıran ve çözümü güç bir felaketi ortak çekirdek olarak sunar. Buradaki büyüklük yalnız ölçü ya da değer değil, olayın şiddeti ve yıkıcı ağırlığıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal şiddetli ve ağır felaketi anlatır; sıradan büyük bir işi, değer büyüklüğünü, kemik anlamını veya yüceltme eylemini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız biçimlerin şiddetli felaket anlamını verir ve başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış büyüklük anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Başa gelen, şiddeti ve ağırlığıyla insanı sıkıştıran, korkunç ve çözülmesi güç büyük felakettir.

facets.statement: Ani ya da ağır biçimde başa gelen şiddetli bir felaket söz konusudur.
Felaketin korkunçluğu, sıkıştırıcılığı ve çözülmesinin güçleşmesi özellikle vurgulanabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, ağır ve korkunç bir felaketi bildirir; şiddet, insanı sıkıştırma ve içinden çıkılması güçleşme bu olayın belirgin özellikleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Felaketin hem başa gelmesini hem de şiddet, korkunçluk ve güçlük niteliğini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Başa gelen ağır olay ile onun şiddetli ve çözülmesi güç oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Şiddetli ve korkunç bir olayın kısa ve doğal biçimde adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olayın felaket oluşunu ve olağanüstü büyüklüğünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Sıkıştırıcılık ve çözülmesi güç olma özelliklerini açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Korkunç ve başa gelen tekil felaket adlandırmasını öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal şiddetli, ağır ve sıkıştırıcı felaket alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal felaket adıdır; komşu dal felaket yanında genel şiddet ve ağır karışıklık durumlarını da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsanı sıkıştıran ve çözülmesi güç bir felaketi gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bağlama göre yalnız büyük ve ağır bir işi de anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal büyük ve korkutucu bir felaketi bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın felaket sınırı belirgindir; komşu dalın kapsamı bazı kullanımlarda genel olarak büyük ve ağır işe açılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kemiği, eklemlerin sert ve dayanıklı yapısal parçası olarak tanımlar ve tekil ile çoğul biçimleri belirtir. Geçici çerçevedeki aşınan ya da kemirilen kemik ayrıntısı bu dalın bağlayıcı kaynak ifadesinde yer almadığından tanıma alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kemiğin kendisini ve çoğulunu kapsar; kalın uzuv kesimini, genel sertliği, eti veya çoğunluk anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bağımsız kemik adını ve onun çoğulunu verir; uzuv kalınlığına veya başka kalıplara ait anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: İskelette ve eklem yapısında bulunan, sertliği ve dayanıklılığıyla belirgin yapısal parçadır; çoğul biçim aynı tür parçaların tümünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İskelet ve eklemlerin sert, dayanıklı yapısal parçası adlandırılır.
Tekil biçim bir parçayı, çoğul biçim ise bu sert yapısal parçaları topluca belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt kemiği bilinen sert ve dayanıklı yapı olarak tanır, eklemlerin yapısındaki yerini belirtir ve tekil biçimin çoğul karşılığını verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İskelet ve eklem yapısındaki sert parçanın tekil ve çoğul kullanımlarını doğrudan karşılayan temel addır.

error_profile.preserves: Sert ve dayanıklı iskelet parçası kimliğini eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür kemiği tekil veya toplu olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eklemleri veya birbirinden ayrılmış tek tek kemikleri özel bir topluluk adıyla belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal iskeletin kemik ve eklem parçalarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel kemik adıdır; komşu dal eklem ya da birbirinden ayrılmış kemik parçalarıyla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Konum ayrımı olmadan kemiğin genel adını verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Parmak, ayak ve hayvan ayağındaki belirli küçük kemik ve eklem gruplarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kemik ve eklem yapısını konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bütün kemik türlerine açık genel addır; komşu dal yalnız belirli konumlardaki küçük kemik ve eklemlere özgüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; seçilen iki aday genel kemik ile belirli eklem ve küçük kemik grupları arasındaki sınırı gösterir, kalanlar yalnız beden, sertlik veya et alanını paylaşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın kendisini üstün görerek böbürlenmesi, kasılması ve zorbalığa yönelmesi üzerinde birleşir. Değerli veya yüce olma değil, kişide yerilen bir kendini büyütme tutumu söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yerilen kibir, böbürlenme ve kurumlanmayı kapsar; gerçek büyüklük, saygınlık, yüceltme veya ürkütücü bulma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bağımsız kibir ve böbürlenme anlamını verir; saygı ve büyüklük bildiren kalıplaşmış kullanımları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisini başkalarından üstün görerek böbürlenmesi, kurumlanması ve bu tutumu zorbalığa kadar vardırmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi kendisini üstün görür, böbürlenir ve kurumlu davranır.
Bu yerilen tutum, başkalarına karşı zorba ve buyurgan davranmaya kadar ilerleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, insanın kendini üstün görmesine dayanan kibir, böbürlenme ve kurumlanmayı bildirir; bu tutumun zorbalık biçimine dönüşebileceği de belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin kendisini üstün görmesine dayanan yerilen tutumun kısa ve doğal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Kendini üstün görme, kibir ve gösterişli böbürlenme yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kibrin dışa vuran kasıntılı ve gösterişli davranış olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Böbürlenmenin dışa vuran kasıntılı davranış yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İçteki üstünlük yargısını ve zorbalığa varabilen kapsamı açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kendini üstün görmeye dayanan kibir ve böbürlenmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek anlam ve kullanım sınırı bakımından yer değiştirebilirler; ayrım yalnız farklı sözcük aileleriyle dile getirilmeleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kibrin iç tutumunu ve zorbalığa varan genel davranışını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Burnu ya da başı kaldırma biçimindeki bedensel göstergeyi özellikle içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kendini üstün görme ve kibirli davranma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel kibir tutumudur; komşu dal bu tutumu belirli bir beden hareketiyle dışa vurur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin kendine haksız üstünlük yüklemesine dayanan yerilen tutumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Toplumca tanınan saygınlık, şeref ve önderliği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin büyüklük ve üstünlükle ilişkilendirilmesini konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öznel ve yerilen kendini büyütmedir; komşu dal başkalarınca tanınan olumlu mevki ve saygınlıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir işi yalnız büyük saymayı değil, onu yadırgamayı veya kişinin gözünde büyüyüp kendisini ürkütmesini anlatır. Olumsuz yapıda ise işin kişiye gözünde büyümemesi ve onu yıldırmaması belirtilir; bu nedenle geçici çerçevedeki saygılı yüceltme çağrışımı çıkarılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir şeyi ürkütücü ölçüde büyük bulma ya da yadırgama tepkisidir; saygıyla yüceltme, genel korku veya kibirlenme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bir işi yadırgama ve gözünde büyütüp ürkütücü bulma biçimleriyle bunların cümle içindeki olumlu ve olumsuz kalıplarını ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi yadırgamak veya onu kişinin gözünde büyüyüp kendisini ürküten, zor ve yıldırıcı bir şey olarak algılamaktır; olumsuz kuruluşta işin kişiyi yıldırmadığı anlatılır.

facets.statement: Bir iş yadırganır ya da kişiye gözünde büyüyerek ürkütücü ve zor görünür.
Kişiyi nesne yapan kalıplar işin onu ürkütmesini, olumsuz kuruluş ise işin onu yıldırmamasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, bir işi yadırgama ile onun kişiye gözünde büyüyüp ürkütücü gelmesini bir araya getirir. Aynı anlatımın olumsuzu, işin kişiyi ürkütmediğini veya yıldırmadığını bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin olağandışı, zor veya ürkütücü bulunarak kişiye büyük görünmesini temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yadırgama, gözünde büyütme ve ürkütücü bulma bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin kişiye zor, büyük ve yıldırıcı göründüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: İşi açıkça yadırgama ve ürküntü duyma yönlerini zorunlu olarak belirtmez.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kalçayı büyük göstermek için kullanılan dolgu nesnesidir; kalçanın kendisi, genel yastık, kemik veya kibir anlamı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak tarifi, kayışları ve diğer donanımı bulunmayan eyer ya da semer iskeletindeki ahşap parçadır. Tanıklıklardan birinde ilk ad öbeği farklı görünse de verilen nesne tarifi aynıdır; bu nedenle dal korunmuş, fakat tanım yalnız açıkça desteklenen ahşap donanım parçasına bağlanmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız eyer veya semerin donanımsız ahşap parçasını anlatır; genel odun, bütün eyer, kayış, metal parça ya da kemik değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız eyer ya da semerle kurulan kalıba ve kayışsız, donanımsız ahşap parça tarifine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Eyer ya da semerin, kayışları ve başka donanımı takılmamış durumdaki ahşap iskelet parçasıdır.

facets.statement: Eyer veya semer yapısına ait bir ahşap parça adlandırılır.
Parça, kayışlar ve diğer donanım eklenmemiş çıplak durumuyla tanımlanır.
Tanıklıklardan birinde ad öbeğinin ilk unsuru farklı görünür, ancak ahşap parçaya ilişkin nesne tarifi değişmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tarif, kayışları ve başka donanımı bulunmayan ahşap bir eyer ya da semer parçasıdır. Tanıklıklardan birinde ad öbeğinin ilk unsuru farklı görünürken nesnenin tarifi aynı kalır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kalıbın eyer ya da semer parçası olma, ahşaplık ve donanımsızlık koşullarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ahşap eyer parçası ile kayışsız ve donanımsız olma koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Parçanın donanım takılmadan önceki durumunun açıklanması gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eyer iskeleti, ahşap malzeme ve donanımsızlık koşullarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iskeletin çıplak ahşap unsurudur; komşu dal bu unsurları birbirine bağlayan işlevsel parçadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eyerin yalnız donanımsız ahşap iskelet parçasını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eyerin tamamını, hayvana eyer vurmayı, eyer yapımını ve bu işi yapanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal binek hayvanına takılan eyer düzeniyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bütünün tek bir ahşap bileşenidir; komşu dal eyerin kendisini ve ona bağlı eylem ile meslekleri içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir eyer parçasını ve onun donanımsız durumunu gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ahşap malzemeyi, tahta parçalarını ve bunlarla kurulan daha geniş kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Odak daldaki nesne ahşaptır ve iki dal malzeme bakımından kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal işlev ve yapı bakımından eyerle sınırlı bir parçadır; komşu dal ahşabın genel adıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin görüş, şan ve toplumdaki mevki bakımından yükselmesini; başkalarınca kendisine saygı gösterilmesini; saygınlık alanlarını ve topluluğun önderlerini birlikte verir. Bu, kişinin kendini üstün görmesi değil, tanınan şeref ve toplumsal ağırlıktır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tanınmış saygınlık, şeref, güçlü görüş ve önderliği kapsar; fiziksel büyüklük, çoğunluk ve yerilen kibir anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, görüş ve şan bakımından yükselme kullanımını toplum içindeki saygınlık, saygı alanları ve önderler bildiren kalıplardan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin görüşü, şanı ve toplumdaki mevkii sayesinde yüksek saygınlık kazanması ve kendisine saygı gösterilmesidir; ilgili kalıplar saygınlık alanlarını ve topluluğun önderlerini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Kişi görüş, şan ve toplumsal mevki bakımından yükselerek tanınmış saygınlık kazanır.
Kişinin toplumdaki ağırlığı, başkalarının ona saygı göstermesini ve dokunulmaz değer tanımasını doğurur.
Çoğul ve kalıplaşmış kullanımlar saygınlık alanlarını veya topluluğun önder ve ileri gelenlerini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, görüş ve şan bakımından yükselen kişinin toplumda saygınlık ve ağırlık kazanmasını anlatır. Aynı alan, kişiye duyulan saygıyı, saygınlık konularını ve topluluğun önderlerini bildiren kullanımlara uzanır.

concept_gloss.text: şerefli ve saygın bir mevki edinme
concept_gloss.applicability: Görüş ve şanla yükselme, toplumca saygı görme ve önderlik çekirdeğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Şeref, güçlü görüş, toplumsal mevki, saygı ve önderlik bağını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Toplumca tanınan mevki ve saygı yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Görüş ve şanla yükselme ile topluluğun önderlerini adlandırma yönlerini açıkça taşımaz.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun saygın önderlerini adlandırma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek kişinin görüş ve şanla yükselmesini ve soyut saygınlık alanlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yüksek toplumsal mevki, şeref ve saygınlık alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel mevki yüksekliğine odaklanır; odak dal saygı görme, görüş gücü ve önderleri adlandırma yönlerine de uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin toplumdaki itibarı, mevkii ve ileri gelen oluşunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görüş, şan ve saygı ilişkisinden hareket eder; komşu dal görünür toplumsal mevki ve seçkin kişiler çevresinde örgütlenir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Toplumca tanınan olumlu saygınlık, şeref ve önderliği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin kendini üstün görmesine dayanan yerilen kibir ve böbürlenmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin büyüklük ve üstünlükle ilişkilendirilmesini konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal başkalarınca tanınan meşru değerdir; komşu dal kişinin kendisine yüklediği yerilen üstünlük iddiasıdır.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
